_comment: Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/CrucibleFurnace/tools/make_shape.py. Native frame, block units, controller cell at [0,0,0]: the front middle cell at ground level, where the ash mouth is. One hole, centred left to right, with two pots side by side in it, pot 1 west and pot 2 east, worked from the front; furnaces stand side by side in a row along x (up to furnace.rowMax), sharing one chimney on one member's outlet, the others capped. No power and no forced air: natural draught, in at the ash mouth (ash, ashSide) under the damper. depth is the lid: 0 open, resting past upright on its two stops (the rest pose), 1 shut, turned about the hinge's axis (hinge), its top back edge. theta is the melter's clock, carried by a ratio-0 rotate on the lid: nothing turns. requires: the build's stages, brickwork, lining and lid (build; the frame, iron, has none); pot1, pot2, charge1, charge2, melt1, melt2, the coke's three layers coke1..3 (from the grate up) and the same burning, fire1..3; the damper's place, damperopen, damperhalf or dampershut (one at a time); and outletcap. The brickwork's texture is the furnace's brick type's (bricks). The six cells over the front two rows are hollow: the lid stands open over the middle row (gameplay's collision for it) and sweeps the front row's as it turns. holeCell: the cell over the hole's middle, worked from its top (a click on the hole is the nearer pot's, pot1 or pot2); outletCell: the stack, in the back row's middle, the chimney stood on its top; chimney: the shortest chimney, counted from the outlet up. See CrucibleFurnace/README.md.

build._comment: The build's stages, in order. frame: the iron frame's grid recipe (with a hammer); placing it puts down the controller and its ghosts, and draws the frame part. Each stage then fits its requires when its materials are all in: brickwork (its alsoParts, the hinge's pins and stops on their ties, come with it at no cost of their own), then lining, then lid (with the damper: also, its places). volumeBlocks: the stage's brick measured from the model, in blocks; its quantities are that at 2 fired bricks or 4 refractory bricks a block (the game's brick block recipes), rounded up, fire clay one per 2.5 refractory bricks. perClick stack: a click puts in as many of the held stack as are still needed. oneType: the first fired brick put in sets the furnace's brick type (bricks), and the rest must match. outletCap: an item interaction, not a stage. The hole's contents and the damper are drawn once the lid stage is in, the cap once the lining is.

bricks._comment: The fired brick types the brickwork takes (every game:burnedbrick type), each with the block its bricks make and that block's texture: the renderer sets the shape's 'brick' code to the furnace's type's base, with its overlays drawn over it (the brick course's cream brick under the type's colour). The furnace's type is the first brick put in; until then no brick is drawn. A type missing here (another mod's) is refused.

furnace._comment: pots: the pots in the hole, pot1 and pot2; potUnits: what each pot's drawn melt holds (PotCapacityUnits); cokeLayers, cokePerLayer: the hole's coke is drawn as its layers coke1.. up to ceil(coke / cokePerLayer) (fire.. while lit); minChimney: chimney blocks stood on the outlet, counted from it up (MinChimneyHeight); rowMax, rowAxis: furnaces in a row, side by side along x, sharing one chimney; lidOpenDegrees: how far the lid opens (the hinge's step).
